part.text:
Added Handlebars template support:

- Page frontmatter: `template` and `layout`
- Defaults: `templates/page.hbs`, `templates/layouts/default.hbs`
- Partials: `templates/partials/*.hbs`
- Raw placeholders: `{{{content}}}` for Markdown and `{{{body}}}` for rendered page content
- CLI option: `--templates <dir>`
- Preserved built-in rendering when no templates directory exists
- Added template, layout, partial, and default-template tests
